data.title: 蕾塞 · 摩天轮烟花
data.description: 夏夜游乐园升至最高点的摩天轮座舱内，绚烂的花火在巨大的玻璃窗外接连炸裂。蕾塞将男士外套松松披在肩头，仰起清秀的脸庞看着满天火树银花，眼底藏着转瞬即逝的落寞——「烟花虽然短暂，但盛开的那一瞬间真的好美啊……就像我和你在一起的时光一样。」
data.location: 夏夜游乐园摩天轮最高处的封闭座舱
data.action: 仰头看烟花，外套披在肩头
data.lighting: 窗外烟花的暖白光照亮侧脸和缝线，座舱底部留冷紫夜色
data.promptProse: At the top of the ferris wheel, Reze sits sideways on the worn burgundy bench inside the enclosed gondola. A borrowed olive flight jacket lies across her shoulders with the sleeves hanging empty. Her hand lightly keeps its collar in place as she lifts her face to a gold firework outside the curved window. A faint reflection catches the glass beside her profile. Below the lower window rail, the lights of the amusement stalls are small and distant. The cabin struts, the close bench and the sky through the windows make separate layers in the same view.
data.animaCaption: Reze sits inside the enclosed gondola with the borrowed jacket draped across her shoulders and its sleeves hanging empty. She looks up through the window at a gold firework, with the tiny park lights far below.
